reuse.why: Fintegra reuses bank lookup, linking and transaction downloading, but replacement copies the local cleanup from unlinkAccount instead of extracting its reusable portion.

duplication.why: The unlink field-reset block is duplicated, while six provider-specific assertion adapters and registration wrappers add repetitive plumbing.

placement.why: Provider configuration and downloading remain in their established layers, but link replacement mutates accounts inside an assertion invoked from handler registration.

scope.why: The changes stay focused on the requested linking rules, replacement option and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate registration guards, provider implementations and duplicated unlink cleanup, while a SimpleFin-named function now exposes Fintegra selection through its request type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountIsNotLinked directly reproduces unlinkAccount's local cleanup; extract that cleanup so replacement can reuse it without invoking provider disconnection.

disguised_duplication.where: The account-link field reset from unlinkAccount is embedded inside assertBankAccountIsNotLinked under validation-oriented naming.

abstraction_drift.where: linkSimpleFinAccount gains source and provider-shape dispatch; the shared link assertion gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch that bypasses unlinkAccount's cleanup abstraction.
